title: 69_Wilson_Highs_Demise

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Would you have eaten the dirty note?

nodes.text: He marches off.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What was that about?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Whatever. I'd better get to class if I'm going to bring down Elliana!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: My name's Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Porscha! That's right. Your name's familiar to me. You used to run with the cheerleaders and the sports gonzos in the before time.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: The before time?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Long ago...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I got sick. Today's my first day back.
Skazz looks over his shoulder... Then rips up the ticket!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'm letting you off with a warning because you're new to how things work now. But listen to me, Cheerleader, you'd better catch on quick or you could end up getting sent to The Depot.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: The Depot?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, it's an express shuttle to Boot Camp. Students go there, but they never come back. I can't be seen talking to you for very long. He could be watching.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Who?
Skazz looks over his shoulder toward a camera mounted in the corner.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Him.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I'm, um, Elliana.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ha! You don't think I know who Elliana is? The Spirit Ambassador herself? How dumb do you think I am?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Just for lying, I'm writing you an additional ticket. Too many and you'll be sent to The Depot.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: The Depot?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: It's an express shuttle to Boot Camp. Students go there, they don't come back, `Porscha.` Yeah, that's right. I remember you.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's an express shuttle to Boot Camp. Students go there, they don't come back, [color=#e23b3b][i]Porscha.[/i][/color] Yeah, that's right. I remember you.

nodes.text: Skazz thrusts the ticket at Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I remember how little respect you had for us gearheads. Well, now you're going to learn to have a lot more respect for us!
After a few more rounds of insults...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You got burned, Elliana!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: No, I didn't! I... I... Didn't!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: How about the next time I go and do something in the tradition of Spirit Week, you show your leader your support?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Whatever. Let's just get on with practice, okay?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You got burned, Porscha...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: 'Burned' is right. You know none of us like it when you go off on some mission for your boyfriend when you should be working on the cheerleading routine!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Well... Well...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Good. Now let's get started... And if you don't mind, Porscha, I'll lead the girls since I'm the one who knows all the steps.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `COUGH! COUGH!` Okay.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]COUGH! COUGH![/i][/color] Okay.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Are you all right? You don't sound so good.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Alexei said he was feeling sick yesterday. Maybe I caught something from him.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Ew. Please keep your kissing disease away from me.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: `Kissing disease?!` Wait! Alexei from the basketball team?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Kissing disease?![/i][/color] Wait! Alexei from the basketball team?!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Yeah, what about him?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: He didn't come to class today. He's got `mono.`
nodes.text_bbcode: He didn't come to class today. He's got [color=#3b78e2][i]mono.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Which means...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: You've got mono, too.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Which means you won't be going to school for a couple months.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Which means I'll be taking over the cheerleading team, officially, `from now on.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means I'll be taking over the cheerleading team, officially, [color=#3b78e2][i]from now on.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `NOOOOOOOOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NOOOOOOOOO![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A month later...
Porscha logs in to a social networking site...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Eeeeg! Elliana's getting so many friends! And what's this?! I've `lost` some?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeeeg! Elliana's getting so many friends! And what's this?! I've [color=#3b78e2][i]lost[/i][/color] some?!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `COUGH! COUGH! This sucks!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]COUGH! COUGH! This sucks![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And another month passes...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: How come no one's been logging in?! I'm so out of touch!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `COUGH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]COUGH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And another month...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I haven't heard from Alexei in forever! I wonder if he's recovered from mono yet? Rumor has it Wilson's been changed somehow. When I go back, it'll be like I'm the new girl!
A few months later, Porscha returns to Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Finally! I'm fully recovered, and I'm ready to reclaim my spot as the most popular girl in school!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Elliana has probably already destroyed my reputation!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I'm not going to be able to overthrow her in one day, but I can at least get started with my plan.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: First, I'll ruin her reputation with a few notes passed in class to the school gossips.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Then, I'll build up my own reputation by working the lunch crowd.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: And finally, after school I can re-affirm my dominance by crushing her in cheer practice!
As Porscha walks to class... The bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: That's weird. The bell's not supposed to ring for another ten minutes!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Halt, you are in violation of Protocol-8: Walking in an unauthorized zone without a hall pass during class time.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What? Class doesn't start for ten minutes!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Protocol-9: Students shall be in their seats and quietly prepared to assimilate all teachings at a time no later than ten minutes before the first bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I am issuing you a ticket. Please state your name for the record.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: What is so wrong with my nose?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Nothing! If you want to look like a zoo creature!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: She's a Brazilian pachyderm!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Have you taken a look at my lips? Are they not perfect?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: They're... Okay. If you like... Fullness.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Her lips really `are` perfect. I don't know what you were thinking, Porscha.
nodes.text_bbcode: Her lips really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] perfect. I don't know what you were thinking, Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: GASP! You did `not` say that!
nodes.text_bbcode: GASP! You did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] say that!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Well, if you `had` money, everyone knows you'd use it for...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if you [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] money, everyone knows you'd use it for...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Who dressed you, your mom?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: My mom?!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Did that one hit too close to home?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: You're talking about `my mom`, Kelliana Fibrana, the fashion designer?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're talking about [color=#3b78e2][i]my mom[/i][/color], Kelliana Fibrana, the fashion designer?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Your mom is Kelliana?! She `invented` the expensive shoe fad!
nodes.text_bbcode: Your mom is Kelliana?! She [color=#3b78e2][i]invented[/i][/color] the expensive shoe fad!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Maybe I know a little bit more about fashion than you... What do `you` think?
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I know a little bit more about fashion than you... What do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] think?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Wow! Her mom's a fashion designer! That would be so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: By the way, I'm surprised you have three hundred dollars leftover for shoes after all the money you use for the surgeries for your face!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Where'd you buy those cheap clothes, Rags 'N' Bags?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Don't worry, Elliana... One day you'll be able to afford fabric to patch up some of those holes.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Whatever!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: All your money buys `you` is the surgeries you use for your face!
nodes.text_bbcode: All your money buys [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] is the surgeries you use for your face!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I can't believe you're wearing that top with those hideous shoes.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: You mean these `three hundred dollar` shoes. Please! Look at your outfit!
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean these [color=#3b78e2][i]three hundred dollar[/i][/color] shoes. Please! Look at your outfit!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I should insult...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: At least I didn't come from Brazil! I bet you grew up eating bugs and snakes!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hey, everything that comes from Brazil is `hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, everything that comes from Brazil is [color=#3b78e2][i]hot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Well...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I wish I came from Brazil...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: And another thing...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: You're one to talk... Who has `blue hair?!` Your head looks like a used toothbrush!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're one to talk... Who has [color=#3b78e2][i]blue hair?![/i][/color] Your head looks like a used toothbrush!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Well, your hair looks... Blonde... And... Shiny...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Ha! Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Heh. 'Used toothbrush'! Elliana's hair fights cavities!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.title: Wilson High's Demise
nodes.subtitle: This note was confiscated by the Wilson Associate Student Police for direct violation of Protocol-12. Please report all subversives to your friendly W.A.S.P. enforcer.

nodes.text: Welcome to a unique episode of Surviving High School from an uncommon perspective!
You're playing as Porscha, the Wilson High head cheerleader!
A few months ago, at Centerscore High during Spirit Week...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Well, well. It looks like even the cheerleaders at this loser school know that they don't have a chance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, doesn't your squad have anything better to do than lurk around our gym? Really, Porscha, it's just pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Just stopping by to have a friendly chat, Taylor. Where's your ugly little school mascot? Aren't you still keeping him in the science lab?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you're here to pull some kind of prank, you can forget it.
After a few more insults...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, get out of here before I call security on all of you little twerps!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: We were just leaving anyway. Come on, girls.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Later... Centerscore losers.
The girls returned to Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Well, well, well. Look who it is, back from whatever lame, pranky thing you were doing over at Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: We were destroying their morale!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Interesting. Sounds like something your new, idiot boyfriend would plan.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Alexei `knows` what he's doing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Alexei [color=#3b78e2][i]knows[/i][/color] what he's doing!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `COUGH! COUGH! COUGH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]COUGH! COUGH! COUGH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Well, while you were being an errand-girl, we were back here, you know, working hard on our `cheering.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, while you were being an errand-girl, we were back here, you know, working hard on our [color=#3b78e2][i]cheering.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Do you have a problem, Elliana? Did I upset your foreign, Brazilian code or something?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Maybe you did. And maybe my problem is you thinking you're somehow `better` than us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you did. And maybe my problem is you thinking you're somehow [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] than us!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Oh! Insubordination!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I've got to maintain my spot as the head cheerleader. I can't let Elliana undermine me with insults. I need to insult...
Skazz and Stiletto escort Porscha to The Depot, where a shuttle is parked in front of a hard, wooden bench. Elliana is there.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Looks like you're finally getting what you deserve! By the way, why did Principal Dyre want me to meet him `here?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like you're finally getting what you deserve! By the way, why did Principal Dyre want me to meet him [color=#3b78e2][i]here?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Stiletto grabs her!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hey! What the...? You're making a mistake! I'm the Spirit Ambassador!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Not anymore you're not! You're an enemy of Dyre. You violated Protocol-30: Hair colors must be acceptably hued.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: What?!
The W.A.S.P's shove Porscha and Elliana onto the bench!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Wait here. Don't try anything cute.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: What's happening? Other than my blue hair, I didn't do anything wrong.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Don't you get it? There isn't anything wrong with blue hair. In a place like this, you don't have to do anything wrong to get in trouble!  It's just decided and that's it!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: But that's unfair!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I know it is... And the same things that are happening here are going to happen to Centerscore! Maybe we should warn them?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Don't we hate them?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Yes, normally. But if we get to them in time, and they expose Dyre, Wilson will probably return to normal!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: They're not our enemies now. For once, we're on the same side...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Just like us...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Okay. I'm in! But how are we going to warn them?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: If you can distract Stiletto, I can get the keys off Skazz's belt and lock the shuttle doors behind me.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: We can steal the shuttle!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Shh!
Porscha creeps up behind Skazz as he's arguing with Stiletto! Elliana tosses a tube of chapstick over their heads! It rattles on the concrete!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Almost there... Almost there... Got 'em!
Porscha grabs the keys from Skazz's belt!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey!
They leap onto the shuttle, shut the door on the W.A.S.P's, and lock it!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Centerscore, here we come!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hahaha! That was great!
Porscha creeps up behind Skazz as he's arguing with Stiletto! Elliana tosses a tube of chapstick over their heads! It rattles on the concrete!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Almost there... Almost there...
Porscha steps on a pro-Wilson leaflet!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Um... `RUUUUUN!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Um... [color=#3b78e2][i]RUUUUUN!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Grrr!
Porscha runs off toward Centerscore, leaving Elliana behind!
After several miles of running...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow! Why is this town so big?!
Suddenly, The Depot Shuttle pulls up next to her! The door opens and...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: How could you just leave me like that?!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: How did you steal the shuttle from the W.A.S.P's?!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I asked you first!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Fine. I wasn't thinking. I just... Reacted. I'm sorry, okay. I'm sorry. Your turn.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I made them think that I was a mole for Principal Dyre and that for a confidential reason he had asked me to take The Depot Shuttle.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Wow. That was smart! Well, again, I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Just shut up, and get in.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Okay, but I get to drive!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Very good. Very good, indeed.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: This morning I would have jumped at the opportunity to be popular. But I don't want it this way.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Careful, girl.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: If I said 'Yes,' what would happen to the current Spirit Ambassador?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Well... Students have a tendency to overstay their welcome.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: That's what I thought! Why don't you take your Protocols and shove them up all your stupid cameras?!
Porscha moves to leave, but Principal Dyre presses the button on his desk, and Skazz and Stiletto come into the office.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Let me guess... The Depot.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Too right.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: In exchange for your... Compliance.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: My compliance?!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Yes... See... I know what you really feel about my brave new Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You want to be able to roam the halls freely before school starts and between classes...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You want to pass notes, exist without cameras, eat during lunch, and root for sports teams with your friends.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: That's what we all want. But it's a fantasy, Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: When I came here, Wilson was a cesspool of delinquency. Walking through the halls, all I heard was talk of pranking Centerscore and who so-and-so would take to the dance.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Now... There is either a healthy discussion of facts or a beautiful `silence.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now... There is either a healthy discussion of facts or a beautiful [color=#e23b3b][i]silence.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: But it isn't fun anymore! And what about all the students who are missing?!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Cooperating students' GPA's are at an all-time high. The troublemakers are gone. Those who remain are compliant.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: In fact, my system is so beloved by parents that soon I'll be expanding beyond the walls of this school and onto... Greener pastures.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: There's no reason you can't have what you want, Porscha. And I can give it to you... Imagine walking down the hall and having everyone know your name.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Imagine everyone worshiping the ground you walk on. Kneeling at your feet. Imagine yourself as the new Spirit Ambassador. Imagine yourself... `Popular.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Imagine everyone worshiping the ground you walk on. Kneeling at your feet. Imagine yourself as the new Spirit Ambassador. Imagine yourself... [color=#e23b3b][i]Popular.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Popular?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: While I'm away, I could use someone of your ilk. Someone who knows her place in my system.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You could become a secret member of W.A.S.P. What do you say?

nodes.prompt: Become a secret member of W.A.S.P?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Become a secret member of W.A.S.P?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I'm willing to overlook the note...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You passed an unauthorized note in class. Very petty.
After school, Porscha steps into the gym and finds Elliana and Alexei standing next to a fenced-off pen of desks filled with studying nerds.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Cheerleaders and nerds together!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Well, well, well. Look who it is, back from her sickly sabbatical. Welcome to SAT prep time.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: SAT prep time?! What is this, Elliana? Where is everyone?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Elliana... I haven't gone by that name since the Old Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I'm the `Spirit Ambassador` now! As for the other cheerleaders, it's just me and Alexei.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm the [color=#3b78e2][i]Spirit Ambassador[/i][/color] now! As for the other cheerleaders, it's just me and Alexei.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Alexei?! Why are you a cheerleader?! Why aren't you playing basketball?!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: There aren't any sports anymore, Porscha. Protocol-2: Sports are subversive and cause degradation of the mind.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: That's absurd!
Porscha sees Steph sitting at one of the desks.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: And Steph, why aren't you cheerleading?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Because I can serve my school better through academics. I'm a nerd. Protocol-15: Exceptional students are forbidden from participating in extracurricular activities other than SAT prep.
Skazz and Stiletto walk in with a man Porscha's never seen before...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Principal Dyre! Okay! Time to cheer!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Follow our lead, Porscha, or you'll be in hot water!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I don't think I want to be in trouble with the new principal!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Ready... Okay!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: { In reading, writing, and 'rithmetic I `am` the best! {
nodes.text_bbcode: { In reading, writing, and 'rithmetic I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] the best! {

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: { And you know I'm gonna get a perfect on my S.A.T. test! {

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: My turn! I just have to make sure to rhyme with test!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Rhyme with test!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: { Doesn't matter whether chick or dude... {

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: { Wilson brings the scholastic aptitude! {
Principal Dyre whispers to Skazz and Stiletto. As the two W.A.S.P. officers march over, he leaves the gym.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Come with us. He wants to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Oh great! Let me get my things.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Not to you, Blue. With Blondie here.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Don't ask questions.
Porscha follows Skazz and Stiletto out of the gym...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: { Doesn't matter whether chick or dude... {

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: { We can get a lot of the right answers, um, stewed? {

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Porscha! The nerds can't concentrate when you don't get the cheer right!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Actually, it's hard to concentrate at all when you guys are...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Oh, no one cares, Steph! File a complaint!
Principal Dyre whispers to Skazz and Stiletto. As the two W.A.S.P. officers march over, he leaves the gym.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Come with us. He wants to talk to you...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: With me?!
Stiletto cracks her knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Don't make this any harder than it has to be.
Skazz and Stiletto escort Porscha out of the gym...
And into Principal Dyre's office...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Please... Have a seat, Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I've been watching you...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Your first day back and...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I guess you `want` to provoke me, Blondie!
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess you [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to provoke me, Blondie!

nodes.text: Stiletto grabs Porscha and drags her out of the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: No! Please not there! `NOOO! ALEXEI, I LOVE YOU! EVEN THOUGH YOU GAVE ME MONO, I LOVE YOU!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Please not there! [color=#3b78e2][i]NOOO! ALEXEI, I LOVE YOU! EVEN THOUGH YOU GAVE ME MONO, I LOVE YOU![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And that was the last anyone saw of Porscha...
Whoops! Looks like Porscha pressed Stiletto's button one time too many! Definitely not the result she wanted and probably not the result you were hoping for.
Play again and see what happens if you're slightly less rebellious!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Good, Blondie. That's what I thought you said. L.U.N.C.H. makes `everyone` happy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Good, Blondie. That's what I thought you said. L.U.N.C.H. makes [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] happy!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I see good things in your future...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Here I was, planning on taking down Elliana and instead Wilson has turned into this lunch-less nightmare. I haven't even `seen` Elliana!
nodes.text_bbcode: Here I was, planning on taking down Elliana and instead Wilson has turned into this lunch-less nightmare. I haven't even [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] Elliana!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Oh no! If this is what's happened to lunch... What's cheerleading going to be like?!
After an hour, Stiletto walks over and inspects Porscha's sign.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Sorry... I don't think now is the right time for a full-scale rebellion.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Fine. But the Steve-o-lution lives on!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hopefully, there'll be a better opportunity to change things later...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I'll make a Centerscore sign, too!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: All right!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: If we want to change things, now's the time!
Skazz and Stiletto fling open the door! Skazz points at Darren!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `That one!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That one![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Me?! What did I do?!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: You violated Protocol-11. Seeing as you are a repeat offender we are under orders to escort you to The Depot.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: `No!` Anything but that! I'm not meant for Boot Camp! These hands aren't meant to dig!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color] Anything but that! I'm not meant for Boot Camp! These hands aren't meant to dig!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: He didn't do anything. I was the one trying to pass `him` a note.
nodes.text_bbcode: He didn't do anything. I was the one trying to pass [color=#3b78e2][i]him[/i][/color] a note.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: But Darren doesn't have a note, Cheerleader.
Porscha crumples up the note, closes her eyes, and shoves it into her mouth!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `Mmmph!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mmmph![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Gross! Gross! Gross! Gross!
Porscha doesn't move...

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Oh great! I'm dead now!
takeciys

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What?! Everyone's studying quietly! Even Alexei and the other jocks!

nodes.speaker: Miss Smith
nodes.text: You're late!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I was outside getting a ticket...

nodes.speaker: Miss Smith
nodes.text: I don't want to hear any excuses. Sit down, be quiet, and study until the bell rings for lunch.
Porscha sits down...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: First the hallway, now this.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Meh. I've got bigger things to deal with...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Like taking down Elliana one note at a time!
Porscha starts writing a note...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: 'Did you hear that Elliana got liposuction?!'

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: This should fly around the school in no time! Now I just have to hand this off to Darren and my work's done. He's the biggest blabbermouth in the whole school...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Psst... Darren! Psst... Darren! Guess what?

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: `Zip. It. Porscha.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Zip. It. Porscha.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Miss Smith
nodes.text: Are you talking back there?
Darren resumes studying. After a minute...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Psst... Darren! I'm trying to pass you a note.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: This isn't Centerscore, Porscha. We can't pass notes here anymore.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: We can only dream of being transferred there. To Centerscore. To paradise.
Porscha throws her note onto Darren's desk. Darren starts furiously scribbling something. He tears out a note, drops it on the ground, and surreptitiously slides it over to Porscha with his foot.
As soon as Porscha touches it...
An alarm blares! Cameras overhead whir in their direction! A voice comes booming over the P.A. system!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Cease and desist! You have been caught violating Protocol-11: Passing notes without permission in a note-free zone. Do not move. `W.A.S.P.` patrol officers are coming to detain you shortly.
nodes.text_bbcode: Cease and desist! You have been caught violating Protocol-11: Passing notes without permission in a note-free zone. Do not move. [i]W.A.S.P.[/i] patrol officers are coming to detain you shortly.

nodes.text: Darren crams Porscha's note into his mouth. Footsteps pound in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Quick! Eat my note!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `Eat Darren's note?!` Gross! It's been on the floor! Eeeeg!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Eat Darren's note?![/i][/color] Gross! It's been on the floor! Eeeeg!

nodes.text: A year later... Porscha is walking down the hall...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Make way! Make way! The Queen of Wilson approaches!
All the students get down on their knees... Except for Alexei...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Thank you, Skazz. My humble citizens, thank you for...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What is this?!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Why are you not bowing?!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'm sick of this! I'm sick of L.U.N.C.H! I'm sick of cheering for nerds!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What happened to you, Porscha? You turned Elliana in, just so you could be Queen!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Remember how things were? Back when we were dating? Remember when our only concern was how we were going to prank Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: That name is never to be mentioned in these halls!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: No one talks to the Queen that way!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Show Alexei to The Depot!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What's happened to you?! Why are you like this?!
As Skazz and Stiletto take Alexei away...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: WAIT! NO! NOOOOO! `I LOVED YOU ONCE! I LOVED YOU, YOU EVIL WITCH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: WAIT! NO! NOOOOO! [color=#e23b3b][i]I LOVED YOU ONCE! I LOVED YOU, YOU EVIL WITCH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Plenty of power for Porscha, but is this really what she wants? Play again and see if you can help her warn Centerscore!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: As the girls are driving the shuttle to Centerscore, police lights flash behind them!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Okay, Elliana, don't panic. Just be calm. I can explain this.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hello, Officer.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What do you think you Bonnies are doing?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Just taking a spin.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This vehicular unit belongs to Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: How do you know that?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Shut up, Elliana!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You think I don't know The Depot Shuttle? It's the reason the Boot Camp is thriving so much! Boot Camp doesn't fill itself!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now where's Skazz? Where's Stiletto?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: You actually know their names?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Elliana!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: How could I not know the names of two of the finest youths in the whole town?!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Uh-oh.
Monte's police radio squawks!

nodes.speaker: Police Radio
nodes.text: Be on the lookout for two criminals who have commandeered The Depot Shuttle. Treat them as hostiles!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You are in violation of Protocol-25: Petty Theft Auto! Put your hands up and keep 'em raised!
At Boot Camp...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Okay, maggots! It's dinner time!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Finally, some food!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: D.I.N.N.E.R. of course stands for `D`igging `I`ndefinitely `N`ow followed by some other letters!
nodes.text_bbcode: D.I.N.N.E.R. of course stands for [color=#e23b3b][i]D[/i][/color]igging [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color]ndefinitely [color=#e23b3b][i]N[/i][/color]ow followed by some other letters!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Basically, you `will` continue to dig until I say stop!
nodes.text_bbcode: Basically, you [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] continue to dig until I say stop!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Eeeg! This is worse than L.U.N.C.H!
How horrible! Porscha's in Boot Camp! Even worse, Centerscore hasn't been warned! Play again and see if you can dig Porscha out of Boot Camp and into a better ending!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: But not quite perfect. Try again for that perfect game so you can unlock the bonus scene!
See you again soon!
The girls arrive at Centerscore and find the cheerleaders practicing in the gym...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: If it isn't the cheer brigade... Have you come to help your boyfriend steal Lyle again?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: No... You don't understand. None of that's important anymore. We're here to warn you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of what? Your greasy hair?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Greasy! Your hair's so damaged it needs its own insurance policy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr! At least mine doesn't look radioactive!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `Girls! Enough!` We're not here for that! We're here to warn you!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Girls! Enough![/i][/color] We're not here for that! We're here to warn you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: About what?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: There's this Principal... He's evil.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: He turned Wilson students against each other! He's implemented all these super strict rules!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: We have to study all the time, we have to work at lunch, and there are cameras everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: He uses signs to control how we think!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Even worse, students get taken away. They disappear!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, I love magic!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That doesn't sound like magic, Manda-Panda. That sounds horrible!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That does sound horrible...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you guys probably deserve it!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: You're not listening! He's coming to Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: It's all part of some big plan... He's going to make school like this... `EVERYWHERE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's all part of some big plan... He's going to make school like this... [color=#3b78e2][i]EVERYWHERE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: None of our parents will stand for this!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Think about it! All of Wilson's test scores are through the roof... If we get in trouble, we get sent to Boot Camp. Otherwise, we have to behave like saints!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: And what do you think our parents think about that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Parents would love that...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If it's even true!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: You have to believe me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We don't have to do anything!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But we'll take your warning into consideration. We'll talk to Principal Shapiro as soon as we're done here.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Thank you, Taylor. Do that. Please. And... And good luck.
The girls leave the gym...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: What happens now?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: We can't go back to Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: And we don't belong here... Hey! Maybe we can go to Brazil for a vacation!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Brazil?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Sure! We can wait there till this plays out. If Centerscore exposes Dyre, we can come back to Wilson... And work on our tans in the meantime!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I won't have to eat bugs, will I?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hahaha! No eating bugs or snakes. And you'll have to fight off beautiful boys with a stick!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Sounds like a vacation!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I'm worried about my friends, though...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Me too...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: But at least Centerscore has been warned now, and if they band together somehow, maybe things will change at Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: We have done a good thing.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Yeah, we have!
Centerscore's been warned! All thanks to Porscha! Even though she didn't become popular, she did the right thing!
You played a subversively great game!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: Skazz grabs the note from Porscha's hand.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `You` do.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] do.

nodes.text: He opens Darren's note.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: 'STOP PASSING NOTES! THEY'RE WATCHING. P.S. SKAZZ'S HEAD LOOKS LIKE A DIRTY BED OF LETTUCE!'

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: The first part is acceptable. The second is clearly an infraction.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What do we do with Lughead here?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: He's a subversive. Always talking about how Centerscore's better because it doesn't have a student militia. Take him to The Depot.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: `Nooooooooooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Nooooooooooo![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As Skazz and Stiletto drag Darren out of the classroom...

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Don't do this to me! Not the Depot! Please `NOT THE DEPOT!` Tell my parents I loved them!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't do this to me! Not the Depot! Please [color=#e23b3b][i]NOT THE DEPOT![/i][/color] Tell my parents I loved them!

nodes.text: The door closes. Studying resumes as though nothing happened.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Doesn't anyone care?

nodes.speaker: Miss Smith
nodes.text: Shh!
And for the rest of the period, the students work silently until the bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Miss Smith
nodes.text: Everybody pack up! It's lunch time!
The students groan.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Why is everyone groaning? Lunch is the best time of the day!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I'm dying for some noodle soup.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: We don't eat during lunch anymore, Porscha. L.U.N.C.H. is an acronym now: `L`abor `U`nder `N`ewly-`C`hiseled `H`appiness.
nodes.text_bbcode: We don't eat during lunch anymore, Porscha. L.U.N.C.H. is an acronym now: [color=#e23b3b][i]L[/i][/color]abor [color=#e23b3b][i]U[/i][/color]nder [color=#e23b3b][i]N[/i][/color]ewly-[color=#e23b3b][i]C[/i][/color]hiseled [color=#e23b3b][i]H[/i][/color]appiness.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What? That's terrible! Our parents won't stand for this!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Our test scores are higher than ever... All the troublemakers get sent to Boot Camp. The only students left are goodie-goodies or those smart enough to pretend to be.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Our parents won't help us! This is their dream! All we can do is rise up! We have to overthrow Principal Dyre ourselves! I'm the leader... I call it The Steve-o-lution! Join me!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Welcome to the new Wilson, sweetie...
Skazz and Stiletto stand in the middle of the cafeteria, handing out blank posters.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Get in a single file line. Grab a poster and a marker. Only `one` marker, Steve!
nodes.text_bbcode: Get in a single file line. Grab a poster and a marker. Only [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] marker, Steve!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Aww... I like the way they smell.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Hey! Don't backtalk an officer!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: We are going to make some signs for Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Some examples...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: 'We are strongest when we watch each other!'

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: 'I put on my quiet face for the cameras...'

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Or 'A Badger's best quality is his silence.'

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What you put on your poster is up to you as long as you pick one of those three. Find a partner and get started.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Want to partner up, Porscha?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Sure. Do you guys have to do this every day?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: L.U.N.C.H? Yeah. It's not always the same task. Sometimes we get to light books on fire!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: It's horrible! This whole thing!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: It is. And now's our time, Porscha! The Steve-o-lution can begin `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It is. And now's our time, Porscha! The Steve-o-lution can begin [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Keep your voice down... How?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: If we make a sign about how great Centerscore is, everyone will join us against the W.A.S.P's. Think about it... There's only two of them!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Couldn't we get in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Of course! That's the point! They can't send `all of us` to The Depot. We can't stand for this. We have to prove our humanity!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! That's the point! They can't send [color=#e23b3b][i]all of us[/i][/color] to The Depot. We can't stand for this. We have to prove our humanity!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Yeah, but, we're `high schoolers!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but, we're [color=#3b78e2][i]high schoolers![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Quiet over there!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Listen, Porscha, I'm going to make `my` sign a Centerscore sign! Join me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, Porscha, I'm going to make [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] sign a Centerscore sign! Join me!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I want things back the way they were... What's the best way to do it right now? Conform or rebel?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Oh, you need evidence? Then I don't have a note, either.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Do you `see` a note?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you [color=#3b78e2][i]see[/i][/color] a note?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No... I don't, actually.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Then I guess it never existed...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hrmph. Very well. Resume studying.
The W.A.S.P. officers march out.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Thanks, Porscha! You saved me!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: We don't eat during lunch anymore, Porscha. L.U.N.C.H. is an acronym now: `L`abor `U`nder `N`ewly-`C`hiseled `H`appiness.
nodes.text_bbcode: We don't eat during lunch anymore, Porscha. L.U.N.C.H. is an acronym now: [color=#e23b3b][i]L[/i][/color]abor [color=#e23b3b][i]U[/i][/color]nder [color=#e23b3b][i]N[/i][/color]ewly-[color=#e23b3b][i]C[/i][/color]hiseled [color=#e23b3b][i]H[/i][/color]appiness.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What? That's terrible! Our parents won't stand for this!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Our test scores are higher than ever... All the troublemakers get sent to Boot Camp. The only students left are goodie-goodies or those smart enough to pretend to be.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Our parents won't help us! This is their dream! All we can do is rise up! We have to overthrow Principal Dyre ourselves! I'm the leader... I call it The Steve-o-lution! Join me!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Welcome to the new Wilson, sweetie...
Skazz and Stiletto stand in the middle of the cafeteria, handing out blank posters.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Get in a single file line. Grab a poster and a marker. Only `one` marker, Steve!
nodes.text_bbcode: Get in a single file line. Grab a poster and a marker. Only [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] marker, Steve!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Aww... I like the way they smell.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Hey! Don't backtalk an officer!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: We are going to make some signs for Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Some examples...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: 'We are strongest when we watch each other!'

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: 'I put on my quiet face for the cameras...'

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Or 'A Badger's best quality is his silence.'

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What you put on your poster is up to you as long as you pick one of those three. Find a partner and get started.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Want to partner up, Porscha?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Sure. Do you guys have to do this every day?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: L.U.N.C.H? Yeah. It's not always the same task. Sometimes we get to light books on fire!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: It's horrible! This whole thing!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: It is. And now's our time, Porscha! The Steve-o-lution can begin `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It is. And now's our time, Porscha! The Steve-o-lution can begin [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Keep your voice down... How?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: If we make a sign about how great Centerscore is, everyone will join us against the W.A.S.P's. Think about it... There's only two of them!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Couldn't we get in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Of course! That's the point! They can't send `all of us` to The Depot. We can't stand for this. We have to prove our humanity!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! That's the point! They can't send [color=#e23b3b][i]all of us[/i][/color] to The Depot. We can't stand for this. We have to prove our humanity!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Yeah, but, we're `high schoolers!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but, we're [color=#3b78e2][i]high schoolers![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Quiet over there!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Listen, Porscha, I'm going to make `my` sign a Centerscore sign! Join me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, Porscha, I'm going to make [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] sign a Centerscore sign! Join me!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I want things back the way they were... What's the best way to do it right now? Conform or rebel?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I knew we shouldn't have let you pair up with Steve!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Centerscore is a paradise!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Shut up! I'll deal with you in a second!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Skazz! Come look at Steve's sign!
Skazz comes over.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `'Centerscore: A camera-free and note-friendly paradise?!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Centerscore: A camera-free and note-friendly paradise?!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: `Another` sign violating Protocol-22.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Another[/i][/color] sign violating Protocol-22.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Come with me.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You know where!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Very good, Blondie. I'm making a note about this...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Skazz! Come look at Steve's sign!
Skazz comes over.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `'Centerscore: A camera-free and note-friendly paradise?!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Centerscore: A camera-free and note-friendly paradise?!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: `Another` sign violating Protocol-22.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Another[/i][/color] sign violating Protocol-22.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Come with me.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You know where!
Skazz escorts Steve out of the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: `NO! NOT THERE! NOT THE DEPOT! TELL MY DOG I LOVE HIM! I LOVE YOU, RUSTY! I LOVE YOU!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]NO! NOT THERE! NOT THE DEPOT! TELL MY DOG I LOVE HIM! I LOVE YOU, RUSTY! I LOVE YOU![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Stiletto, what's happened here? What's happened to Wilson?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Improvement, Blondie.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Improvement? But look around. You can't mean that. You have to see that L.U.N.C.H. `sucks!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Improvement? But look around. You can't mean that. You have to see that L.U.N.C.H. [color=#3b78e2][i]sucks![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What did you say? And before you answer, I want you to think really really hard about this!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Because I'm pretty sure I heard you say that L.U.N.C.H. makes you `happy.` That is what you said, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I'm pretty sure I heard you say that L.U.N.C.H. makes you [color=#3b78e2][i]happy.[/i][/color] That is what you said, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: He made Blondie make one, too. What should I do with her?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No... Just give her a ticket! She's new.
Stiletto writes Porscha a ticket...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: One more ticket, Blondie, and you'll be taken to The Depot! Just like him!
Stiletto points toward Skazz.
Skazz escorts Steve out of the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You received two tickets for tardiness. Unpleasant. Most unpleasant.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You created pro-Centerscore sentimentality with improper signage, earning yourself a ticket... Can't say I agree with that.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: And just now you were disruptive of S.A.T. prep time, our most serious extracurricular activity.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Overall, I'd say you were exceptionally well-behaved...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: As well as your other transgressions...
In fact, you were subversively perfect! Here's your bonus scene!
Meanwhile, back in the gym...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, we have to go tell Shapiro!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We will, alright? But don't be naive, $ZOE. Do you really think the cheerleaders at `Wilson` came here just to warn us about some new principal?
nodes.text_bbcode: We will, alright? But don't be naive, $ZOE. Do you really think the cheerleaders at [color=#3b78e2][i]Wilson[/i][/color] came here just to warn us about some new principal?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They're probably here to distract us so they can steal Lyle again.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I've had it with trying to protect Lyle from those idiots!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're going to tell Shapiro that we've had enough of this immaturity!
The cheerleaders burst into Shapiro's office!
Boxes filled with Shapiro's things are piled around the room!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Principal Shapiro, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm cleaning out my office, girls.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And Hector and Keith...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I can't talk about this now. If you'll excuse me...
Shapiro picks up a moving box, and the girls watch her leave the office.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you understand what this means, you guys?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Porscha was `right!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Porscha was [color=#3b78e2][i]right![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Later that night...
A shaky hand knocks on an unfamiliar door.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Who is it?! Who's out there?! I'll arrest you, fooligan!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: It's me, Monte-Carlos. I-I didn't know where else to go.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What's wrong, my Muffin?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Don't call me that!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Sorry for snapping at you... I just... It's just that...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm being replaced!
Looks like Dyre's on his way to Centerscore! Trouble's brewing!
Check out our upcoming episodes to find out what happens next!
As the girls are driving toward Centerscore, Porscha slams on the brakes!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Exactly! `What` am I doing?! Why would I warn those Centerscore losers?! Would they warn us?! How could I pass up an offer to be `popular?!`

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
